Confirmed imports stay in file-protected local Application Support and are excluded from backup. Accounts, grades and raw webpages are not saved. Delete or refresh the offline snapshot in Settings.
Cookie、缓存与本地存储由 WebKit 保存在本机沙盒内，四个站点各用独立: WebKit stores cookies, cache and local storage in the device sandbox, separately for each of the four sites.
Moodle PDF 先进入临时预览，点击下载后才保存。默认保存在本机 Docu: Moodle PDFs open in temporary preview and are saved only when you tap download. New files use Documents/Downloads or your selected folder. Existing files stay in place. External folders are excluded from timed cleanup. Temporary previews are removed when closed; resume credentials remain in memory.
由学校官方页面自行处理，App 代码不接触、不记录、不发送。: Handled by the official school pages. App code does not read, record or transmit them.
保存显示、启动、浏览、锁定及下载保留偏好、四站容器标识。开启恢复页面时，仅保存不: Stores appearance, startup, browsing, lock and retention preferences, and isolated site-store identifiers. Optional page restore saves plain site URLs without query parameters, forms, authentication URLs or passwords.
由 iOS 系统校验面容 ID / 触控 ID / 设备密码，App 只收到成功: iOS checks Face ID, Touch ID or the device passcode. The app receives only the result, never biometric data.
网页会访问所打开的站点、页面资源与登录服务。主动运行诊断时，向四站公开首页发送不: Webpages contact their own sites, resources and sign-in services. Diagnostics send cookie-free HEAD requests to public homepages. There is no custom backend or analytics SDK. Dark appearance reads referenced CSS only; it does not fetch remote theme scripts, analyze images or read form values.
App 声明不追踪、不收集数据；唯一声明的 API 用途是 UserDefaul: No tracking or data collection is declared. UserDefaults is used for local preferences only.

四个站点各自持久保存网页会话，可单独清除，也可用面容 ID 遮挡。: Each site keeps its own persistent session, can be cleared separately, and can be protected by Face ID.
SwiftUI + WKWebView，最低 iOS 17（使用带标识符的持久化: SwiftUI + WKWebView, iOS 17+, with identified persistent WKWebsiteDataStore containers.
四站独立数据容器，切换标签不重新加载页面。: Four independent stores; switching tabs does not reload the page.
网页文件保存在本机，支持进度、取消、可用时续传、预览及系统另存。: Local downloads support progress, cancellation, available resume, preview and system export.

没有后台推送与定时轮询；打开 App 才能看到最新页面。: No push notifications or background polling. Open the app to see updated website content.

Signing out or clearing Moodle website data also clears the cache. Assignment content, grades, attachments, and session keys are not stored.
